description: All four evaluable binding channels -- including ch1, the one binding_canonical ships -- give the Ursell three-body cumulant ratio b3/b2 a NEGATIVE value, against a measured +0.6411239316. The three bond-additive channels cluster near -1 for the reason TypeWeightedChainRatio proves; ch1 sits at -1.3995 because it is not additive, so the two structural families fail separately. Closes the qou-brng b3 arc: no channel the corpus can evaluate produces a positive b3, and a sign is not repairable by magnitude.

assertions.name: EVERY evaluable channel gives b3 the WRONG SIGN
assertions.detail: all four are negative against a measured +0.6411239316; margins 251-318%, so the producer's ~8 significant figures are ample for a sign test

assertions.name: the SHIPPED channel is among them
assertions.detail: ch1 = -1.3995. This is the channel binding_canonical actually ships, and the one none of the earlier exclusions in this arc could reach

assertions.name: the three bond-additive channels cluster near -1
assertions.detail: ch3, ch4, ch5 = [-0.9679, -0.9681, -1.0205]. On the chain they sum one term per bond and A=3 has twice A=2's bond count -- the same ratio-of-2 that TypeWeightedChainRatio proves pins b3/b2 to -1

assertions.name: ch1 differs BECAUSE it is not additive -- two families, two failures
assertions.detail: ch1 = -1.3995, away from the additive cluster. Its trace prefactor |tr_p|^Z|tr_n|^N is exponential in A, so it fails SEPARATELY rather than as one shared artefact -- which makes the joint negative harder to blame on a single modelling choice

assertions.name: the failure is a SIGN, so no magnitude repair reaches it
assertions.detail: no normalisation, anchor, convention or overall scale changes the sign of b3/b2; a positive measured value against four negative models is qualitative

scope: (b) on the four EVALUABLE channels of the seven-channel taxonomy, invariant named: the sign of b3. (a) on the three not evaluated there (ch2 needs per-partition characters and is self-marked refuted; ch6 needs Vol(K_bind), which the corpus has only for A <= 3 and which is 0 for the deuteron; ch7 is a deprecation candidate carrying acknowledged-anchor constants). Nothing here says the framework cannot have a positive b3 -- it says none of the four channels that can currently be computed produces one.
caveats: PRECISION. The B/A inputs are the taxonomy producer's printed output at ~8 significant figures. Ample for a SIGN test with 251-318% margins; NOT enough for a precision claim, and none is made. A high-dps re-derivation would change no digit that matters here.
This uses the CHAIN bond set, which StrandLayoutForcesChain proves is forced by the strand layout rather than chosen -- so the shared negative is not an artefact of a bond-set choice.
b4 is not tested. The A=4 row is carried in the table but the quad cumulant needs the A=4 carrier's six pairs, which is a different object and untouched by this arc.
ch2/ch6/ch7 are classified from source in the taxonomy, not re-evaluated there or here. Calling the arc closed over ALL seven would overstate what was measured.
